name: Alcoa
outlook:
What Alcoa says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: operational tax expenseBased on current alumina and aluminum market conditions, Alcoa expects fourth quarter 2026 operational tax expense to approximate $65 million to $75 million, which may vary with market conditions and jurisdictional profitability.
  • Full year 2026: interest expenseAlcoa expects Interest expense to approximate $185 million for the year, an increase from the prior projection, as a result of the Notes issuance.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: other incomeOther income is expected to increase by approximately $20 million in the fourth quarter 2026 due to higher interest earned on cash held for the AliGroup acquisition.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 15, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
